req.title: Reject wrong method on /patch
req.statement: The system shall respond with HTTP 405 for methods other than PATCH on /patch.

doc.reasoning: The requirement states that /patch must accept PATCH and reject all other HTTP methods with 405. Tests cover: (1) positive - PATCH succeeds with 200 and correct JSON payload keys; (2) negative - GET, POST, PUT, DELETE each return exactly 405; (3) boundary - HEAD and OPTIONS (edge-case methods) also return 405; (4) decision-table covering all common wrong methods systematically; (5) BVA on the exact status code 405 vs adjacent values to catch constant mutations.

tests.name: test_patch_method_returns_200_with_expected_payload
preconditions: httpbin Flask app is importable in-process
actions: Send PATCH request to /patch with JSON body
expected: Response JSON contains keys: url, args, form, data, origin, headers, files, json
tests.executable:
from httpbin.core import app
client = app.test_client()

def test_patch_method_returns_200_with_expected_payload():
    r = client.patch('/patch', data=b'{"key": "value"}', content_type='application/json')
    assert r.status_code == 200
    body = r.get_json()
    assert isinstance(body, dict)
    for key in ('url', 'args', 'form', 'data', 'origin', 'headers', 'files', 'json'):
        assert key in body, f'Missing key: {key}'
    assert body['json'] == {'key': 'value'}

test_patch_method_returns_200_with_expected_payload()

tests.name: test_get_on_patch_endpoint_returns_405
preconditions: httpbin Flask app is importable in-process
expected: HTTP 405 Method Not Allowed (exactly 405, not 404 or 400)

tests.name: test_patch_only_method_allowed_all_others_rejected
preconditions: httpbin Flask app is importable in-process
actions: Send GET, POST, PUT, DELETE (each should return exactly 405)
trace: R-HTTPBIN-009 BVA: exhaustive method boundary - only PATCH is in the allowed set
tests.executable:
from httpbin.core import app
client = app.test_client()

def test_patch_only_method_allowed_all_others_rejected():
    r_patch = client.patch('/patch')
    assert r_patch.status_code == 200
    wrong_methods = [
        ('GET', client.get('/patch')),
        ('POST', client.post('/patch')),
        ('PUT', client.put('/patch')),
        ('DELETE', client.delete('/patch')),
    ]
    for method_name, resp in wrong_methods:
        assert resp.status_code == 405, f'{method_name} expected 405 got {resp.status_code}'

test_patch_only_method_allowed_all_others_rejected()

tests.name: test_patch_response_json_structure_exact_keys
preconditions: httpbin Flask app is importable in-process
actions: Send PATCH request to /patch with form data
Inspect response JSON for exact key set
expected: JSON body has exactly the keys: url, args, form, data, origin, headers, files, json
trace: R-HTTPBIN-009 positive: payload structure matches view_patch get_dict call
tests.executable:
from httpbin.core import app
client = app.test_client()

def test_patch_response_json_structure_exact_keys():
    r = client.patch('/patch', data={'field': 'val'}, content_type='application/x-www-form-urlencoded')
    assert r.status_code == 200
    body = r.get_json()
    expected_keys = {'url', 'args', 'form', 'data', 'origin', 'headers', 'files', 'json'}
    assert set(body.keys()) == expected_keys
    assert body['form'] == {'field': 'val'}
    assert body['json'] is None

test_patch_response_json_structure_exact_keys()
